AboutPage.Title: About PageToMovie
AboutPage.Lead: Turn a book or story into a short film.
AboutPage.Intro: Import your text and PageToMovie helps you shape it into a screenplay, choose a visual style, cast the characters, and generate the scenes — then watch and share the finished movie.
AboutPage.StepBook: import your story and shape the screenplay.
AboutPage.StepLook: pick the visual style and fit the film to your budget.
AboutPage.StepCast: give each character a look, and an optional voice.
AboutPage.StepFilm: generate the scenes, then watch and share.
